card.text: Explore Gryphia in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Gryphia tumbles, so this approximate shape uses a fixed illustrative orientation. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Thermal diameter 14.403 ± 0.394 km; quoted fit error excludes about 20% systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects. The shape reconstruction assumes rotation around one principal axis; the incomplete tumbling solution is not propagated.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 7.2015 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height. The orientation is fixed and illustrative.
